about_the_game:
Have you ever dreamed of crafting beautiful floral arrangements that brighten someone’s day?

Flowers and Favours is a cozy and relaxing florist simulator where you can design unique bouquets, experiment with real-life flower varieties, and run your very own flower shop. This is your space to create, unwind, and bring joy to adorable animal customers.

What’s in the Demo:

Listen and Learn – Chat with adorable customers to understand their stories and craft the perfect bouquet for each one.

Unleash Your Creativity – Use intuitive, flexible tools to design one-of-a-kind bouquets.

Wrap It Up – Choose from a variety of elegant wrapping options, ribbons, and finishing touches to complete your masterpiece.

Visit the Flower Market – Discover and buy new flowers daily to expand your collection.

Coming in the Full Release:

  • 100+ unique floral types, 20+ wrap designs, and lots of decorative accessories

  • Photo Mode – Capture your favorite bouquets and store them in a memory book

  • Shop Customization – Decorate your flower shop and make the space your own

  • Creative Workbench – Personalize your crafting area to match your style

Hi! I’m Iris 👩‍💻
I'm a solo developer bringing Flowers and Favours to life with lots of love and care. I hope you enjoy the demo—and thank you so much for playing! 🌸

Minimum:
  • OS: Mojave 10.14+
  • Processor: Apple Silicon, x64 architecture with SSE2
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics should be enough
  • Storage: 250 MB available space
